**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. - *Docket SEO in Claude Desktop on Windows.* The release now carries a Windows bundle for Claude Desktop and other MCP
  clients (Docket-1.3.152-windows-x64.mcpb), beside the Mac and Linux ones. Open it with Claude Desktop to install Docket's
  audit engine as an extension: ask Claude to audit a site and the audit runs on your own computer. The engine inside is the

  the engine now reads it as no key and gives the free result, instead of reporting a key that was never entered.

99 checks across 13 areas.
